story: Maya is leaving town for two weeks and empties her kitchen into her communities instead of the trash: three food items offered as giveaways, claimed by neighbors and friends before she goes.

items.title: Spaghetti (2 boxes)
items.description: Two unopened boxes of dried spaghetti, straight from the pantry.

items.title: Sourdough Loaf
items.description: A whole crusty sourdough loaf, uncut and bakery-fresh.

items.title: Fresh Broccoli
items.description: Two crisp broccoli crowns, ready to steam or roast.

spaghettiChat.text: Ooh I could grab this — we're never not out of pasta.
I literally have a pot of red sauce simmering right now and zero noodles 🍝
Dana that's destiny. It's yours — porch pickup any time after 4?
Perfect, I'll swing by at 5. Sauce thanks you!

breadChat.text: Soup night at ours tomorrow — this is perfect. I'll take it!

broccoliChat.text: Roasting these tonight 🥦 thank you Maya!
